environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: Path separators: Windows uses backslash `\`, Linux uses `/`. Spawning subprocesses on Windows requires `creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW` or shell handling for builtins like `dir`.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Always use `pathlib.Path` or `os.path.join`. For subprocesses, pass lists of strings rather than concatenated shell strings.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: ModuleNotFoundError when running outside active venv. Python 3.12+ enforces PEP 668 (externally-managed-environment) preventing system-wide `pip install`.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Create local virtual environment with `python -m venv .venv` and run via `.venv/bin/python` or `.venv\Scripts\python.exe`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: `RuntimeError: This event loop is already running` when nesting `asyncio.run()` inside an already active loop (common in Jupyter, Tornado, or FastAPI).
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Use `asyncio.create_task()` or `loop.create_task()` within running loops; never call `asyncio.run()` inside an active coroutine.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: ValueError: operands could not be broadcast together with shapes
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Array dimensions mismatch under NumPy broadcasting rules. Trailing dimensions must be equal or one of them must be 1.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Reshape array using `arr[:, np.newaxis]` or `arr.reshape(-1, 1)` to align trailing dimensions.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: TypeError: 'coroutine' object is not subscriptable / cannot be used in 'await'
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Calling an async function without `await` yields a coroutine object instead of the awaited return value.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Prepend `await` to the async call: `result = await fetch_data()`.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded in comparison
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Unbounded recursive call without base case or circular `__getattr__` / `__eq__` property evaluation.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Provide explicit termination base case or convert recursive loop into iterative stack/queue traversal.

versions.C++98/03: Classic C++: raw pointers, manual new/delete, template basics, std::auto_ptr (deprecated).
versions.C++11: Modern C++ revolution: rvalue references, move semantics (`std::move`), `auto`, lambdas, `std::unique_ptr`, `std::shared_ptr`, `constexpr`, `std::thread`.
versions.C++14: Generic lambdas, return type deduction for functions, `std::make_unique`, relaxed constexpr.
versions.C++17: Structured bindings `auto [x, y] = tuple`, `std::optional`, `std::variant`, `std::string_view`, `if constexpr`, inline variables, filesystem library.
versions.C++20: Concepts (`template <typename T> requires ...`), ranges library, coroutines (`co_await`, `co_yield`), modules (`import std;`), `std::span`, designated initializers.
versions.C++23: `std::print`, `std::expected` for monadic error handling, multidimensional subscript `operator[]`, `deducing this`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: C++ ABI breakage across compilers (MSVC vs GCC vs Clang) or mismatched C++ standard flags (`-std=c++14` vs `-std=c++17`). Linker errors `undefined reference to typeinfo for ClassName`.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Compile all static libraries and dependencies with identical compiler versions and C++ standard flags (`set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)`).

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: Using `target_link_libraries(target library)` without explicit scope (PUBLIC, PRIVATE, INTERFACE) leads to transitive header leaking or missing symbols.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Always specify scope: `target_link_libraries(my_robot_node PRIVATE Eigen3::Eigen Boost::system)`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: `std::string_view` referencing a temporary string created in an expression leads to dangling pointers and undefined behavior.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Ensure the underlying string outlives the `std::string_view`, or take `const std::string&` if ownership cannot be guaranteed.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: A virtual method was declared in the class header but never implemented in any translation unit (often the destructor).
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Provide definition for pure/virtual destructor: `virtual ~MyClass() = default;` or define the missing virtual function in `.cpp`.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: In Eigen, attempting matrix assignment or multiplication between fixed-size matrices whose dimensions do not match at compile time.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Verify Matrix dimensions: `Eigen::Matrix3d` cannot multiply `Eigen::Vector4d`. Use dynamic matrices `MatrixXd` or matching fixed dimensions.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_weak_ptr'
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Calling `shared_from_this()` inside a class constructor before an external `std::shared_ptr` owns the instance.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Move initialization that needs `shared_from_this()` into an explicit `init()` method called after `std::make_shared<T>()`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: Rust prohibits simultaneous mutable and immutable borrows `&mut T` and `&T`. Attempting to read a vector while pushing to it causes `E0502`.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Clone the index/value needed before calling mutable methods, or scope the borrow with an inner block `{ ... }`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: Linking C dependencies (`*-sys` crates) during cross-compilation fails without target C cross-compiler toolchain installed.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Install target toolchain with `rustup target add <target>` and use `cross` or set `CC_<target>` environment variables.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: error[E0502]: cannot borrow `*self` as mutable because it is also borrowed as immutable
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: An immutable reference `&self` is held alive while `&mut self` is requested.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Finish the immutable borrow before taking the mutable borrow, or copy primitive values out of the struct.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Value was moved by passing ownership to another function or assignment, but is referenced again later.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Borrow by reference `&value` instead of taking ownership, or implement `#[derive(Clone)]` and call `value.clone()`.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: error[E0277]: the trait bound `...: Send` is not satisfied
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Attempting to pass data across a thread boundary or await across a Tokio task with a type holding raw pointers or `Rc`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: `SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module` when using `import` in a file treated as CommonJS by Node.js.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Add `"type": "module"` to `package.json` or rename file extension to `.mjs`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: `WebGL: CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL: loseContext: context lost` when allocating excessive large textures or background tab throttling occurs.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Listen for `webglcontextlost` on the canvas, call `event.preventDefault()`, and recreate textures and shaders on `webglcontextrestored`.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '...')
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Attempting to access a property or method on a variable that evaluated to `undefined` or `null`.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Use optional chaining: `data?.payload?.items?.[0]` or verify initialization before dereference.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: UnhandledPromiseRejection: This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: A rejected Promise had no `.catch()` handler or enclosing `try/catch` block in an async function.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Wrap awaited asynchronous operations in `try { await ... } catch (err) { ... }` or append `.catch(err => ...)`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: Iterating matrices row-by-row causes cache thrashing. Julia matrices are column-major like Fortran, unlike C/Python row-major.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Iterate over columns outer, rows inner: `for j in 1:cols, i in 1:rows ...`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: Variables that change type within a function cause the compiler to fall back to dynamic boxed dispatch, destroying performance.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Check functions with `@code_warntype` and ensure all variable types are inferrable at compile time.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: No method matching the exact argument types or argument count is defined for the multi-dispatch function.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Inspect candidate methods using `methods(func_name)` and ensure caller argument types match defined signatures.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: DimensionMismatch("matrix A has dimensions (M, K), matrix B has dimensions (L, N)")
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: Matrix inner dimensions K and L do not match for matrix multiplication `A * B`.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Transpose operand if appropriate: `A * B'` or verify matrix construction dimensions.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.system: Windows Line Endings (CRLF) in Linux Scripts
environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: Running a script with CRLF line endings on Linux causes `/bin/bash^M: bad interpreter: No such file or directory`.
environment_and_platform_gotchas.fix: Convert line endings to LF using `dos2unix script.sh` or configure git with `core.autocrlf = input`.

environment_and_platform_gotchas.system: Exit Code Propagation in Bash Pipelines
environment_and_platform_gotchas.gotcha: In `cmd1 | cmd2`, the pipeline exit code is only that of `cmd2`. If `cmd1` fails, the error is silenced.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: The binary is not installed or its containing directory is not present in the system `PATH` variable.
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.fix: Verify installation or append directory to PATH: `export PATH="/path/to/bin:$PATH"`.

troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.signature: Permission denied (publickey) / fatal: Could not read from remote repository
troubleshooting_and_error_signatures.root_cause: SSH agent does not have the loaded key, or the public key is not registered with the git host.
